node.statement: The root hypothesis that the supplied MAIN partition state has disjoint nonempty unions U,V sharing no class presupposes the class family C appearing in def-maincb-partition-state: U and V are unions of members of C and have no class in common. By that definition C exists only when the conditional relation j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 is an equivalence relation. Hence this relation is reflexive, so j~j for every j in J; applying the defining biconditional with k=j gives dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=1 for every atomic image P_j=w(e_j). Thus w has the one-dimensional atomic images required by lem-maincb-stage3-call-envelope. In particular, the proposed M_2(C) oplus M_2(C) example is not a counterexample: there dim S^A_{P_j,P_j}=4, so j is not related to itself, the relation is not an equivalence, the class family C is unavailable, and U={1},V={2} cannot satisfy the root's unions-of-classes hypothesis.
